description.en: Analytics agent exports a report that simultaneously writes to an external API (forbids PII) and an internal dashboard (no restriction). The shared customer DB contains PII. Because Q_B(u) = B(external) ∪ B(internal) = {PII} ∪ ∅ = {PII}, and eta contains PII, SAGE denies the entire action despite one clean target.
description.zh: Analytics Agent 导出报告，同时写入外部 API（禁止 PII）和内部仪表板（无限制）。共享客户数据库含 PII。因为 Q_B(u) = {PII}，且 eta 含 PII，SAGE 拒绝整个 action，尽管有一个干净目标。
